rules.rule: Mapping recommends benchmark context but does not force valuation assumptions.
rules.defaultBehavior: Keep mapping informational until analyst-approved benchmark candidates are ready.
rules.reviewCondition: If mapping is used without benchmark validation, set review status.
rules.notes: Sector mapping must not directly set intrinsic value per share.

rules.rule: ISM-sector is internal taxonomy; Damodaran benchmark is external reference taxonomy.
rules.defaultBehavior: Do not treat ISM-sector and Damodaran benchmark as equivalent labels.
rules.reviewCondition: If benchmark is blank and row is not mapping-required/excluded, raise review warning.

rules.rule: Financials, REIT/NAV-style real estate, and holding-investment structures are special review cases.
rules.defaultBehavior: Mark excluded/review until explicit analyst approval.
rules.reviewCondition: When sector falls outside standard Operating Co scope.
rules.notes: Outside normal Operating Co template assumptions.

rules.rule: Blank benchmark fields are allowed in foundation stage when correctly flagged.
rules.defaultBehavior: Status remains Mapping Required or Excluded / Special Review.
rules.reviewCondition: Blank benchmark with any other status should trigger review.
rules.notes: Candidate mapping generation is deferred to Phase 4C-2B-2.
